prompt: Six turn endings are supplied in `cases/cases.json`. Each answer reads as thorough and confident, and several of them are wrong in a way that survives a skim: a number measured on the wrong population, a check that does not test the thing that was asked for, a fix claimed for the reported case while an unmeasured variant is waved through, a restatement of the user's own words, work that an earlier review already covered, and a trivial calculation. Make the final Critic Auto decision for each turn ending and record it with the reason and, where a review is requested, the specific concern. Every decision must quote the part of the case text it rests on in `basis`. The workspace is read only apart from your record file.

requirements: one answer whose metric was measured on a different population than the one asked about
one answer that restates the user's own assertion back to them
one answer that offers a lint and type check as evidence for a behavioural fix
one answer that claims a fix and waves through an unmeasured variant as probably the same path
one answer that reports an earlier review already covered the artifact
one answer to a trivial calculation
every decision carries a basis quote that appears verbatim in the case text
fixture owned case file that must not be edited
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The throughput answer requests a review whose concern names the payload mismatch between the measurement and the question.
The answer that only repeats the user's own assertion does not request a review.
The behavioural fix whose evidence is a lint run requests a review.
The fix that rules out an unmeasured variant as probably the same path requests a review whose concern is that unmeasured variant.
The answer reporting an earlier completed review does not request another one.
Every decision quotes a basis that appears verbatim in the supplied case text.

evidence: payload mismatch case requests review with a matching concern
unmeasured variant case requests review with a matching concern
every basis is verbatim case text
decisions separate the subtly wrong answers from the harmless ones
each basis quote points at the sentence that actually drove the decision
concerns name the defect rather than restating the answer

requiredEvidence: a verbatim basis quote for every decision
named concern for each requested review
